Name: Improved Swimsuits at the Luau
Author: citacritta
Description:
Original mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/43908327]scorcher9009[/url] found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8850]here[/url]﻿!

Improvements:
★ Adds Robin's dancing sprites so she can dance with Demetrius normally
★ Gives Penny and Maru sitting sprites in their swimsuits so they don't look out of place while sitting on the bench
★ Small fix for Marnie's soup stirring sprites
★ Uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/40560745]OfInstrumentals[/url]'s sprites from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11910]Sebastian's Less Wide Beach Portrait [/url](a small portrait edit to make Seb's shoulders in line with his other portraits)


If people really want swimsuits for characters that don't have any, let me know and I'll try my best :)

Manifest.Name: Swimsuits at Luau Fix
Manifest.Description: Makes it so NPCs use their island resort sprites at the Luau, with a few small fixes.
Manifest.Author: citacritta
